label: The spectrum of biopsy proven glomerular disease in a tertiary hospital.
summary: To analyse the spectrum of biopsy-proven glomerulonephritis and associated demographic and clinical characteristics in patients undergoing ultrasound-guided renal biopsy. The prospective, cross-sectional, descriptive study was conducted at the Department of Nephrology, Ayub Teaching Hospital, Abbottabad, Pakistan, from April 5, 2023, to December 30, 2024, and comprised adult patients with biopsy-proven glomerulonephritis.
